title: GC-MS: electron ionization and retention indices
summary: Combine EI fragmentation patterns with method-matched retention indices, while separating molecular-ion assignments, library candidates, and identity claims.
zh_summary: 结合 EI 碎裂模式与方法匹配的保留指数，同时区分分子离子归属、谱库候选与身份结论。

title: Mixed spectra and spectral deconvolution
zh_title: 混合谱图与谱图解卷积
summary: Use chromatographic evidence to reconstruct component spectra, inspect non-unique solutions, and distinguish GC-EI mixtures from LC-MS/MS precursor attribution.
zh_summary: 利用色谱证据重建组分谱图，检查非唯一解，并区分 GC-EI 混合谱与 LC-MS/MS 前体归属问题。

title: Molecular-formula inference from mass and isotope evidence
zh_title: 从质量与同位素证据推断分子式
summary: Test ion assignments, exact-mass windows, elemental constraints, isotope patterns, and fragments without confusing a formula with a structure.
zh_summary: 检验离子归属、精确质量窗口、元素约束、同位素分布及碎片，避免混淆分子式与结构。

title: Stable-isotope tracing: from labeling patterns to metabolic questions
zh_title: 稳定同位素示踪：从标记分布到代谢问题
summary: Design a tracer experiment, interpret corrected isotope-label distributions, and separate molecular labeling, atom enrichment, and metabolic flux.
zh_summary: 设计示踪实验、解释校正后的同位素标记分布，并区分分子标记比例、原子富集程度及代谢通量。

title: PCA and scaling: explore variation without overclaiming
zh_title: PCA 与缩放：探索变异，避免过度解读
summary: Read scores, loadings, and explained variance while checking how transformation, scaling, missingness, and study design shape the picture.
zh_summary: 理解得分、载荷与解释方差，并检查变换、缩放、缺失及实验设计如何塑造图中的模式。

title: Pathway enrichment: connect measured changes to biological hypotheses
zh_title: 通路富集：从测量变化到生物学假说
summary: Define compound identities, the tested background, and the enrichment question before interpreting a pathway result as biological evidence.
zh_summary: 在将通路结果解释为生物学证据前，明确化合物身份、检验背景与富集问题。
